verdict.rationale: Spline's docs say collaborators can "give feedback in place" in a shared multiplayer file. That implies some in-file review capability, but it is a single thin mention with no detail on how comments work. Missing for 10: explicit commenting-on-design documentation, @mentions of teammates, resolving threads, notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email

citations.quote: Several people can edit the same file at the same time and give feedback in place, the way they would in a 2D design tool.
is multiplayer from the ground up: your files live in the cloud and several people can edit the same one at once
